variants.subject: A thought on why customers lapse — and how to fix it
variants.body:
We think about this a lot.

Hi {{firstName|there}},

Most customers who stop ordering from DabbahWala don't do it because the food was bad.
They stop because life gets busy. Routines shift. The habit breaks.

{{RANDOM | And once the habit breaks, restarting feels like more effort than it is | And once it's gone, ordering feels like a conscious decision rather than just something you do | The hardest part is the restart, not the habit itself}}.

A subscription solves this. Instead of relying on yourself to reorder, meals just show up on your chosen days.

You can adjust or pause anytime. No commitment beyond what you want.

If you're open to it, reply Subscribe and we'll set something up. Or start with a single order using DWALAFEB15 (15% off, $50 min, 30 days) and see if the routine sticks.
